newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa to seek cargo unit alliances.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa to seek cargo unit alliances.

text.p: German airline Lufthansa AG said on Wednesday it would seek similar alliances for its cargo operations as it now has for passenger services.
Lufthansa chief executive Juergen Weber told the group's annual general meeting that the airline was currently in talks to build the alliance.
He said cooperation efforts in cargo operations with United Airlines and SAS -- two airlines with whom Lufthansa is allied for passenger services on code-share flights -- has made "good progress".
But he would not give information on potential partners for the cargo operations.
Lufthansa also currently cooperates with Qantas and Singapore Airlines SIA on cargo operations.
